Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a brand new transparent animation sheet for the Vigile enemy, matching the attached Costard's painted retro shooter style ONLY. Do NOT reuse his suit or gun.
Character: very broad stocky imposing2m tall security man, dark short beard, mediumtan face and bare hands. Navy peaked security cap, navy jacket and trousers, yellow stripe around chest and sleeves continuing across back, black boots, utilitybelt. LEFT arm carries one rectangular riot shield, smokygray translucent pane with black rim and yellow horizontalband. RIGHT hand carries ONE short black baton. No second baton or extra hand. Shield rests ahead of left torso. Front view: shield on imageRIGHT, batonhand on imageLEFT. Back view: shield on imageLEFT, batonhand on imageRIGHT.

Columns everyrow: FRONT, FRONT-RIGHT facing imageRIGHT, RIGHTPROFILE, BACK-RIGHT, BACK, BACK-LEFT, LEFTPROFILE, FRONT-LEFT facing imageLEFT. Keep exact turnarounds.
